 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ousmane Dembélé, Marquinhos, and Nuno Mendes all remain absent for Paris Saint-Germain, who travel to face Le Havre AC on Friday night, the club has confirmed.
 Mendes came off with a muscular injury during the win over RC Strasbourg Alsace, which prevented him from featuring against Barcelona in the UEFA Champions League. It was in the game against the Spanish giants that PSG sustained several injuries.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Ousmane Dembélé was quickly withdrawn against the Catalan club with a thigh injury. Marquinhos was withdrawn with a muscular injury later in the encounter. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia also came off. The Georgian has sustained an ACL injury and will miss much of, if not the remainder of, the season.
 The injuries sustained by Dembélé, Marquinhos, and Nuno Mendes are more short-term, however, none will be fit enough to feature against Les Ciel et Marine. 
 PSG head to Normandy top of Ligue 1 following a tough start to the season. Didier Digard's side, meanwhile, are rock bottom.
 GFFN | Luke Entwistle
